facts.description:
Set to rise along the banks of the Singapore River, Promenade Peak by Allgreen Properties presents a rare opportunity to own a luxury home in one of Singapore’s most coveted central locations. Located at Zion Road and within walking distance to both Great World MRT and Havelock MRT, the development combines urban convenience with a tranquil riverside lifestyle.
This 63-storey residential tower will be the tallest along the Singapore River, offering 596 thoughtfully designed units with commanding views towards Orchard, Marina Bay Sands, and Sentosa. Residents can enjoy direct access to the scenic river promenade, creating a seamless connection between home, nature, and lifestyle destinations.
Designed by DCA Architects and constructed by Woh Hup, Promenade Peak sits on a land area of approximately 99,973 sqft with a 99-year lease commencing from 7 August 2024.
In addition to its prime central address, Promenade Peak is within 1km of highly sought-after schools such as River Valley Primary School and Alexandra Primary School, making it an ideal choice for families. 
The development is also located near key amenities such as Great World City, Zion Food Centre, and Robertson Quay, offering a well-rounded lifestyle for both homeowners and investors.
From an investment perspective, Promenade Peak stands out with a land rate of $1,304 psf ppr, which is comparable to prices seen in fringe or suburban developments. With harmonised unit sizes and efficient layouts, the price gap between central and non-central new launches is now narrower, providing greater value for buyers looking at central region.
As one of the flagship developments under Allgreen’s portfolio, Promenade Peak is poised to continue the legacy of excellence following the success of Great World City. With a surge of new launches expected in 2025, this project is anticipated to be one of the most significant releases in the Central Region.
